title: CHAPTER 9: CURRENT AFFAIRS AND RECENT DEVELOPMENTS IN TELANGANA

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Infrastructure development in Telangana focuses on major urban transport projects including the Hyderabad Metro Rail, Outer Ring Road (ORR), and Hyderabad Airport.
Education initiatives aim at enhancing quality infrastructure, expanding higher education, and driving skill development across the state.
The Power Sector emphasizes continuous 24x7 power supply to agriculture, industrial growth, and energy grid expansion.
The Telangana Model of Governance highlights flagship welfare schemes, balanced regional growth, and efficient public administration.

blocks.content: Hyderabad Metro Rail is one of the largest metro rail projects in India built on PPP (Public-Private Partnership) mode. L&T Metro Rail (Hyderabad) Limited is the concessionaire.

items: Phase 1: Three corridors covering 69.2 km operational
Corridor 1: Miyapur – LB Nagar (Red Line – 29 km)
Corridor 2: JBS – MGBS (Green Line – 15 km)
Corridor 3: Nagole – Raidurgam/HITECH City (Blue Line – 27 km)
World's second longest metro under one concessionaire (after Moscow)

blocks.content: CHAPTER 9: CURRENT AFFAIRS AND RECENT DEVELOPMENTS IN TELANGANA
The 158 km Outer Ring Road (ORR) circles Hyderabad and connects all major national highways. It has been a game-changer for connectivity and real estate in Hyderabad's periphery.
Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (RGIA) at Shamshabad, opened in 2008, is one of India's busiest and most modern airports. It is operated by GMR Hyderabad International Airport Limited (GHIAL).

cells: Premier university established 1918; oldest in south India

items: Singareni Collieries Company Limited (SCCL) – Jointly owned by Telangana (51%) and GOI (49%); mines coal in Godavari Coalfields
TSGENCO (Telangana State Power Generation Corporation) – Owns and operates thermal and hydro power plants
TSNPDCL & TSSPDCL – North and South power distribution companies
Bhadradri Thermal Power Station – 1080 MW; near Kothagudem
Yadadri Thermal Power Station – 5x800 MW; supercritical technology; near Yadagirigutta
Kakatiya Thermal Power Station – Chelpur, Karimnagar
NTPC Ramagundam – National Thermal Power Corporation plant in Telangana
Frequently tested: Key milestones, length, and phases of the Hyderabad Metro Rail and Outer Ring Road (ORR) projects.
Important for TSPSC: Flagship schemes and administrative policies comprising the 'Telangana Model of Governance'.
Pay attention to recent developments in power generation capacity and 24x7 agricultural power supply initiatives in Telangana.

blocks.content: Telangana has been recognized for several governance innovations since its formation:

items: Dharani Portal – Single window for land records and mutation; replaced physical records
TS-iPASS – Transparent approvals for industries; 'deemed approval' if no response in 15 days
T-Fiber – Laying optic fiber to all 12,769 gram panchayats for internet connectivity
Palle Pragati / Pattana Pragati – Cleanliness and development drives
Digital Seva Portal – Citizen services online
